segments.zh: 有时我认为它还会包括某种类型的家具，放在餐桌旁边，你可以把盘子放在那里，你可以保存你的茶杯等等。

segments.en: What's that called?
segments.zh: 那叫什么？

segments.en: That's called a buffet.
segments.zh: 这叫自助餐。

segments.en: And that's basically, it's like a dresser for your dining room.
segments.zh: 这基本上就像你的餐厅的梳妆台。

segments.en: Right, exactly.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: It's got like drawers and stuff for your plates, your cups, like you said, and it's next to the dining room table.
segments.zh: 就像你说的那样，它有抽屉和你的盘子、杯子的东西，它就在餐桌旁边。

segments.en: But the dining room set or the dining set is for the dining room.
segments.zh: 但是餐厅套装或餐厅是为餐厅准备的。

segments.en: It's the table where you eat dinner.
segments.zh: 这是你吃晚餐的桌子。

segments.en: Okay, very good.
segments.zh: 好，很好。

segments.en: And now moving on to that special chair that I am a big fan of.
segments.zh: 现在转向我非常喜欢的那把特殊椅子。

segments.en: It's very comfortable to sit on and it's called a recliner.
segments.zh: 坐着很舒服，它被称为躺椅。

segments.en: So we have a word here, recline.
segments.zh: 所以我们在这里有一个词，斜倚。

segments.en: It means to lie back, to put your head back, to get comfortable.
segments.zh: 这意味着向后躺，把头向后，让你感到舒适。

segments.en: So a recliner is a chair that you can change the shape of to make you lie down flat.
segments.zh: 所以躺椅是一种椅子，你可以改变形状，让你平躺。

segments.en: So when you sit down, you're sitting, but what if you want to lie down in a chair?
segments.zh: 所以当你坐下时，你是坐着的，但如果你想躺在椅子上怎么办？

segments.en: This chair lets you do that.
segments.zh: 这把椅子可以让你做到这一点。

segments.en: And it also, from the bottom part where your feet are, a little thing pops up so you can rest your feet on top of this little extension of the chair.
segments.zh: 而且，从你脚所在的底部，一个小东西突然出现，这样你就可以把脚放在椅子的这个小延伸部分的顶部。

segments.en: Okay, so it has a built-in footrest.
segments.zh: 好的，所以它有一个内置的脚踏板。

segments.en: Footrest, exactly.
segments.zh: 脚踏板，确切地说。

segments.en: So it's very comfortable.
segments.zh: 所以很舒服。

segments.en: It's very popular.
segments.zh: 它非常受欢迎。

segments.en: If you ever watch the series Friends, they have the recliners.
segments.zh: 如果你看过系列的朋友，他们有躺椅。

segments.en: It's very comfortable to watch sports, for example.
segments.zh: 例如，观看运动非常舒适。

segments.en: You have your beer.
segments.zh: 你有你的啤酒。

segments.en: Joey has his recliner.
segments.zh: 乔伊有他的躺椅。

segments.en: And remember when Joey and Chandler lived together, they have the two recliners in front of the TV.
segments.zh: 还记得当乔伊和钱德勒住在一起时，他们把两个躺椅放在电视前。

segments.en: Those chairs are recliners and they're very, very popular.
segments.zh: 那些椅子是躺椅，非常非常受欢迎。

segments.en: Actually I think in the United States, they're very commonly known by the brand, Lazy Boy.
segments.zh: 其实我认为在美国，他们很常见的品牌，懒惰的男孩。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: There's a brand.
segments.zh: 有一个品牌。

segments.en: It's not a kind of furniture, but it's the name of the brand.
segments.zh: 它不是一种家具，而是品牌的名称。

segments.en: It's Lazy Boy and they're very, very famous.
segments.zh: 这是一个懒惰的男孩，他们非常非常有名。

segments.en: You're right, Marco, for their reclining chairs.
segments.zh: 马可，你是对的，因为他们的躺椅。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So Lazy Boys, you may hear it, but the real word for it is called a recliner.
segments.zh: 所以懒惰的男孩，你可能会听到它，但它的真正词被称为躺椅。

segments.en: So a lot of interesting pieces of furniture there.
segments.zh: 所以那里有很多有趣的家具。

segments.en: I think our house is going to look amazing.
segments.zh: 我认为我们的房子会看起来很棒。

segments.en: So why don't we go back and listen to the dialogue one last time.
segments.zh: 那么我们为什么不回去听一次对话。

segments.en: How about this floor lamp?
segments.zh: 这个落地灯怎么样？

segments.en: Fine.
segments.zh: 行吧。

segments.en: Just get it.
segments.zh: 只要得到它。

segments.en: We have been shopping for furniture for five hours.
segments.zh: 我们已经买了五个小时的家具。

segments.en: I'm so tired.
segments.zh: 我太累了。

segments.en: We still need to find an armoire and a dresser.
segments.zh: 我们还得找一个衣柜和一个抽屉柜。

segments.en: Fine.
segments.zh: 好吧。

segments.en: I'm going to go home and drop off this nightstand, coffee table, and loveseat while you look for the rest of the things.
segments.zh: 那我先把床头柜、茶几和双人沙发送回家，你继续挑其他东西。

segments.en: Great.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: Pick me up in about an hour because I think I'll also get a beanbag and a dining set.
segments.zh: 大约一个小时后接我，因为我想我还会得到一个豆袋和一个餐具。

segments.en: While you're at it, can you pick up a nice recliner?
segments.zh: 那你顺便挑把舒服的躺椅，好吗？

segments.en: I really want one so I can watch TV.
segments.zh: 我真的很想要一台，这样我就可以看电视了。

segments.en: Recliner?
segments.zh: 躺椅？

segments.en: In my beautifully decorated living room?
segments.zh: 在我装饰精美的客厅里？

segments.en: I don't think so.
segments.zh: 我不这么认为。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So talking about furniture, it's very interesting.
segments.zh: 所以说到家具，这很有趣。

segments.en: How do you take it home?
segments.zh: 你怎么把它带回家？

segments.en: What do you do?
segments.zh: 你是做什么工作的？

segments.en: In this case, they were transporting it themselves.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，他们是自己运输的。

segments.en: The guy said, I'm going to go home and drop off this nightstand, coffee table, and loveseat.
segments.zh: 那家伙说，我要回家把这张床头柜、咖啡桌和双人沙发放下。

segments.en: So to drop off.
segments.zh: 所以下车。

segments.en: Okay, this is a great verb.
segments.zh: 好吧，这是一个很好的动词。

segments.en: To drop off.
segments.zh: 下车。

segments.en: It's a verbal phrase.
segments.zh: 这是一个口头短语。

segments.en: So the preposition there is off, not on.
segments.zh: 所以那里的介词是关闭的，而不是打开的。

segments.en: So I could say, for example, Marco, I'm just going to drop off my bag at home and then I'll meet you guys for dinner.
segments.zh: 所以我可以说，例如，Marco，我只是要把我的包放在家里，然后我会和你们见面吃饭。

segments.en: That means I'm going to go to my house and put down my bag and then I'll leave.
segments.zh: 这意味着我要去我家放下我的包，然后我会离开。

segments.en: So to drop off is basically to go somewhere so you can put something in that place.
segments.zh: 所以下车基本上就是去某个地方，这样你就可以把东西放在那个地方。

segments.en: But it doesn't mean that you're going to go to that place and stay there.
segments.zh: 但这并不意味着你要去那个地方并留在那里。

segments.en: So if I say, I'm going to drop off the kids at school, that means I'm going to take the kids and leave them at school and then go away.
segments.zh: 所以如果我说，我要把孩子们送到学校，这意味着我要带孩子们把他们留在学校，然后离开。

segments.en: It doesn't mean you're going to school yourself.
segments.zh: 这并不意味着你自己去上学。

segments.en: So can you drop off the laundry at the dry cleaners, please?
segments.zh: 那么你能把洗衣店的衣服放在干洗店里吗？

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So drop off the laundry to the dry cleaners, leave it there and then go somewhere else.
segments.zh: 所以把衣服放到干洗店里，把它留在那里，然后去别的地方。

segments.en: So what happens at three o'clock when the kids are still at school?
segments.zh: 那么当孩子们还在上学时，三点钟会发生什么？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Now we use the opposite verbal phrase and that is to pick up.
segments.zh: 现在我们使用相反的口头短语，那就是接听。

segments.en: Okay, drop off, pick up.
segments.zh: 好的，下车，接机。

segments.en: So you go pick up the kids.
segments.zh: 所以你去接孩子。

segments.en: You go pick up the laundry.
segments.zh: 你去取衣服。

segments.en: So this isn't just about picking something up from a table or the ground.
segments.zh: 所以这不仅仅是从桌子或地面上捡东西。

segments.en: You can actually use your car to pick something up.
segments.zh: 你实际上可以用你的车来取东西。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: You go and retrieve it.
segments.zh: 你去取回它。

segments.en: So I'm going to the post office to pick up my package.
segments.zh: 所以我要去邮局取我的包裹。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So phrases that you're going to have to use if you're talking about furniture, if you're talking about buying something.
segments.zh: 所以，如果你在谈论家具，如果你在谈论买东西，你将不得不使用的短语。

segments.en: And while we're on the topic, I know that one of the most popular places to buy furniture is Ikea.
segments.zh: 当我们讨论这个话题时，我知道最受欢迎的购买家具的地方之一是宜家。

segments.en: Are you a big fan of Ikea?
segments.zh: 你是宜家的忠实粉丝吗？

segments.en: I like Ikea and I love what they've done for people who don't want to spend too much money on furniture.
segments.zh: 我喜欢宜家，我喜欢他们为不想在家具上花太多钱的人所做的一切。

segments.en: Furniture is expensive.
segments.zh: 家具很贵。

segments.en: Furniture is very expensive.
segments.zh: 家具很贵。

segments.en: You can spend $5,000 on a sofa.
segments.zh: 你可以在沙发上花 5,000 美元。

segments.en: And so Ikea is a wonderful brand and I think a wonderful company because it makes good-looking furniture affordable.
segments.zh: 所以宜家是一个很棒的品牌，我认为这是一家很棒的公司，因为它使漂亮的家具价格实惠。

segments.en: And it's because you put it together yourself, right?
segments.zh: 这是因为你自己把它放在一起，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: A lot of things you have to assemble or put together by yourself.
segments.zh: 很多东西你必须自己组装或组合在一起。

segments.en: So you buy it in a box and then you make it.
segments.zh: 所以你在一个盒子里买它，然后你就做了。

segments.en: It's a little bit frustrating sometimes, but for people like me, and I'm sure people like you, part of the fun is putting stuff together.
segments.zh: 有时这有点令人沮丧，但对于像我这样的人来说，我相信像你这样的人，部分乐趣就是把东西放在一起。

segments.en: Yeah, because you kind of feel like you kind of built it, but you really didn't.
segments.zh: 是的，因为你觉得你有点建造它，但你真的没有。

segments.en: So it kind of gives you that false sense of accomplishment.
segments.zh: 所以它给了你那种虚假的成就感。

segments.en: It's like I'm in the 19th century and I can make my own furniture.
segments.zh: 就像我在 19 世纪一样，我可以自己做家具。

segments.en: So it's very popular.
segments.zh: 所以很受欢迎。

segments.en: And apart from having great furniture, I understand that they have amazing meatballs.
segments.zh: 除了拥有出色的家具外，我知道他们有很棒的肉丸。

segments.en: They do.
segments.zh: 他们会。

segments.en: Well, I'm a Swedish.
segments.zh: 嗯，我是瑞典人。

segments.en: I never get to eat Swedish meatballs.
segments.zh: 我从不吃瑞典肉丸。

segments.en: And here in China, they do have some of the better meatballs around.
segments.zh: 在中国，他们确实有一些更好的肉丸。

segments.en: So I would recommend if you haven't tried them, try them.
segments.zh: 所以如果你还没有尝试过，我会推荐它们，试试它们。

segments.en: They're pretty good.
segments.zh: 他们相当不错。

segments.en: Yeah, go to IKEA.
segments.zh: 是的，去宜家。

segments.en: Go to IKEA, have some dinner.
segments.zh: 去宜家吃晚饭。

segments.en: Let me know.
segments.zh: 让我知道。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: Do you like IKEA and do you love their meatballs?
segments.zh: 你喜欢宜家吗？你喜欢他们的肉丸吗？

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 到时候在那里见。

segments.zh: 再见。
